unit.why: An anecdote: the Shidlovtse rebbe, spending Shabbat with the Sanzer rav and ordered to say Torah, gets out of it with a homily on 'it is better to hear than to speak'.
unit.boundary_note: Numbered item א) in a series of teachings; next division (ב) continues with a pure teaching of the same rebbe.

stories.start_quote: פ"א שבת אדומ"ו משידלאויצי זצ"ל אצל
stories.summary_en: When the rebbe of Shidlovtse spent Shabbat with the Sanzer rav and was ordered to say Torah, he did not want to disobey or to speak at his host's table, so he expounded 'Moses heard and it was good in his eyes' as meaning that listening to Torah is better than saying it, fulfilling both obligations at once.
